name: Cost Baseline

blocks.description: S-curve line chart of cumulative cost over time. Vertical axis is unlabelled, gridlines at 0, 2,000, 4,000, 6,000, 8,000, 10,000, 12,000 and 14,000. Horizontal axis is unlabelled, periods 1 to 7. A single sample line rises slowly from about 500 at period 1, steeply through periods 3 to 5 (about 11,500), and flattens near 13,300 at period 7.

notes: Landscape page. The form prints no legend, axis titles or Document Element table; the curve and the numbers are sample values, not fields. The prose says the chart is called an S-curve.
